current_metrics.methodology_label:
Same-country linker real-yield butterfly (curvature) on a single
sovereign linker curve (e.g. USD_TIPS 5s10s30s real-yield,
GBP_LINKER 2s10s30s real-yield, EUR_FR_LINKER 2s10s15s real-yield,
CAD_RRB 5s10s30s real-yield).  Computed per-trade-date via the
FIXED simple-butterfly weighting:

  butterfly_pct = belly_real_yield_pct
                - 0.5 * (short_real_yield_pct + long_real_yield_pct)

where ``short_real_yield_pct`` / ``belly_real_yield_pct`` /
``long_real_yield_pct`` are the linker real-yield levels at
``short_tenor`` / ``belly_tenor`` / ``long_tenor`` respectively
(each computed by ``get_real_yield_level`` filtered by
``instrument_type='inflation_linker'`` AND ``curve_family=?``
AND ``tenor=?`` AND ``field_name=?`` — the no-proxy guard
inherited transitively).  The three endpoint series are aligned
per-trade-date via a strict pandas inner-join on calendar
trade_date AFTER each is computed independently; the butterfly
is computed only on dates where ALL THREE endpoints exist (no
synthetic butterfly points are produced).

Fixed simple-butterfly weighting (-0.5, +1.0, -0.5 on
short/belly/long).  Equivalent to
``0.5 * (2 * belly - short - long)``.  Sign convention:
POSITIVE = belly is CHEAP versus the half-weighted wings;
NEGATIVE = belly is RICH.  Matches sovereign_bonds/butterfly's
sign convention (which uses the mathematically-equivalent
doubled form ``2*belly - short - long`` in BPS).

Same-country / same-curve-family construction only: the input
layer accepts a single linker ``curve_family`` field so cross-
curve combinations cannot be expressed.  Compute additionally
re-asserts that the resolved instrument_master rows for that
curve_family map to a single (country, currency) tuple under
``instrument_type='inflation_linker'`` (a defensive guard
against an instrument_master inconsistency), surfacing a
controlled error envelope on mismatch.

The output is the curvature of the REAL-YIELD curve, distinct
from a real-yield curve spread (2-point difference) and from a
nominal sovereign butterfly (3-point curvature of nominal
yields, reported in BPS).  Real yields are quoted in PERCENT and
the butterfly is reported in PERCENT — same units as the
underlying — NOT in BPS.  Daily / weekly / monthly *changes* of
the butterfly are reported in BPS, matching the desk convention
for change reporting on any rate level.

time_series_butterfly.description: Same-country linker real-yield butterfly (curvature) for USD_TIPS (5Y/10Y/30Y; belly - 0.5*(short+long)) over the displayed window.  Curvature of REAL YIELDS for (US, USD) linkers — distinct from a real-yield curve spread (2-point difference) and from a nominal sovereign butterfly (3-point curvature of nominal yields, in BPS).  Quoted in PERCENT (same units as the underlying real yields).

time_series_zscore.description: Rolling z-score of the USD_TIPS real-yield butterfly (in PERCENT) over 5Y/10Y/30Y vs its own trailing window.
